# Witherspoon Home Care

Witherspoon Home Care is a family-owned, non-medical in-home care agency serving Forsyth County, North Carolina, including Winston-Salem and surrounding communities.

## Contact
- Phone: 336-842-9744
- Email: witherspoonhomecare@gmail.com
- Service area: Forsyth County, NC

## Services
Witherspoon Home Care provides the following in-home support services:
- Companion Care & Safety Sitting: A caregiver stays with the client to provide companionship and supervision, reducing fall risk and isolation.
- Rehab Support (PT/OT Exercises): Helps clients stay consistent with physical and occupational therapy exercises between appointments.
- Medication Reminders: Timely reminders to take medication as prescribed, helping prevent missed or duplicate doses.
- Meal Prep, Hydration & Feeding Help: Meal preparation, hydration encouragement, and feeding assistance when needed.
- Daily Preparation: Respectful assistance with dressing and daily hygiene routines.
- Errands: Pharmacy pickups, grocery runs, and other errands.
- Light Housekeeping & Home Comfort Care: Light housekeeping to keep the home clean, safe, and comfortable.

Witherspoon Home Care provides non-medical support only. It does not provide skilled nursing or clinical medical care, and reinforces (rather than replaces) the care plan set by a client's medical team.

## Why in-home care
- 75% of seniors say they want to stay in their own home as they age (AARP 2024 Survey).
- In North Carolina, in-home care averages about $28/hour, often less overall than the average assisted living facility cost of about $5,769/month.
- North Carolina's senior population (65+) is projected to reach 2.7 million by 2040, up from about 1.8 million today, and more than 10,000 NC residents are on waiting lists for home-based services.
